title: One Block Talking Blocks
description: Start from a single regenerating block and expand your sky island—while every block you break talks back with funny and unexpected voice lines.
body:
Unique survival adventure where the classic One Block challenge meets with the mod of Talking Blocks. 

Starting from a single regenerating block floating in the void, you must gather resources, expand your island, and progress through multiple phases—just like traditional One Block gameplay—but with a hilarious twist.

With the included talking blocks mod, every block you break reacts with its own voice lines, comments and more.

- Living blocks that talk
- Voicelines can be heard when you break ANY block

The pack comes with performance and optimization mods.
